comment: The ranking followed the large progress gaps, with architecture informing the leading pair: C's normalized residual depth was favored over A's shallow zero-LN network, while both had substantially stronger optimization than E, D, and B. E's Adagrad progress estimate exceeded those of the two plain-SGD candidates; D's tenfold SGD learning-rate advantage over B outweighed B's rectifier activation. K1001, K1002, K1003, and K1012 helped calibrate these gaps. K1080 cautioned against treating normalized depth as an automatic multivariate winner, so C over A remained the least certain comparison. No new general rule was established.
